presets.name: Anime Detail Fix (faces, then hands)
presets.commercial_note: Repaints crops with WAI v17 (Illustrious); WAI hashes do not authenticate its creator and its commercial terms are unresolved. The source image keeps its own terms.
presets.description: Two Impact Pack FaceDetailer stages detect and repaint faces, then hands, with WAI v17. Denoise is face-only: the face defaults to 0.40 and the hand pass stays fixed at 0.45. The positive prompt also steers the face; hands retain their authored prompt. Lighter/Stronger face variants do not change hand strength. Check detected regions and both results; lower face strength is not a hand-preservation setting. For adjustable hand strength, select WAI Auto Hand Detail (anime-hand) or open its shipped visual workflow: 27 - WAI Auto Hand Detail. This is a separate hand-only pass, not the combined face/hand recipe. The changed Studio control mapping has not been rerun; historical results are retained separately.
presets.execution_note: Executed 2026-09-12 through Studio job 14caa4fb-5999-497f-8b73-0bb2562229df (prompt 3eeba334-6161-4f84-bd36-de0c888c0d74) on the authored example image in 36.2 s; both detector passes fired and the output was inspected (evidence in experiments/curated/anime-fantasy-atelier). Not an art approval. Historical authored graph: face 0.40 / hand 0.45, with no denoise control in the retained recipe. presets.name: Qwen Atelier - 1 Reference
presets.description: Heavy 20B edit: one run of this recipe measured 672 s (about 11 min) on this PC on 14 September 2026; expect a similar wait per image and group these jobs. An identity reference carries who the character is, not how it is drawn: add a style reference (the 3-reference recipe) or name the art style in the brief, otherwise the result takes Qwen's own rendering. Assign identity, pose and style separately. Every reference is scaled to 1.0 MP with its aspect preserved; the canvas is set on its own and no longer follows a reference. Role guidance is compiled into the editable brief. Semantic guidance does not guarantee exact pose or protected pixels.

reference_slots.contribution: Face, hair, proportions, distinctive costume and accessories
reference_slots.avoid: Unrequested changes to identity or costume

reference_policy.slots: every slot is scaled to 1.0 MP before both encoders; no slot is fitted to a width
reference_policy.secondary: native Qwen encoder preprocessing: semantic branch ~384x384, reference-latent branch ~1 MP on the 8-pixel grid
reference_policy.vae: the encoder rounds each scaled reference to a multiple of 8
reference_policy.budget: max_reference_pixels caps the authored per-reference target (megapixels x 1024^2), which is what the compiler checks; the recorded resized and vae sizes are the node's and the encoder's own rounded results and can sit a fraction of a percent either side of it
reference_policy.canvas: explicit EmptySD3LatentImage; output size is independent of every reference

presets.name: WAI • Fooocus inpaint repair
presets.commercial_note: Repaints a manually masked region with WAI v17 (Illustrious) through the Fooocus inpaint patch. WAI is held from a mirror and its hashes do not authenticate its creator; its commercial terms are unresolved. The two patch files (inpaint_v26.fooocus.patch, fooocus_inpaint_head.pth) are byte-identical to lllyasviel/fooocus_inpaint, which carries no licence tag on Hugging Face, and the upstream Fooocus project is AGPL-3.0. Recorded, not cleared. The source image keeps its own terms.
presets.description: The stronger correction pass for a finished SDXL-family anime image, at zero download: the Fooocus inpaint patch (already installed) is applied to WAI v17 so the repaint is conditioned on the surrounding picture instead of guessing from noise, which is what lets a fairly high denoise redraw a broken hand without inventing a new subject. Upload a same-size RGBA PNG with the picture retained in RGB, every protected area opaque and only the repair region transparent; ComfyUI's LoadImage MASK output is already 1 - alpha, so the transparent region is the repaint region with no inversion node. The mask is grown 8 px and the same grown mask drives the encode and the final composite. The encode is the pack's own INPAINT_VAEEncodeInpaintConditioning, not the core VAEEncodeForInpaint: the core node erases every masked pixel to 0.5 grey before encoding, so its README requires denoise 1.0, while this node keeps the existing content in the sampled latent and puts the erased copy in the conditioning, which is what makes a denoise below 1.0 legitimate. Its latent_inpaint output feeds Apply Fooocus Inpaint and its latent_samples output feeds the sampler. There is no FeatherMask node on purpose: ComfyUI's FeatherMask fades the mask tensor's own borders, not the edge of a region inside it, so it would do nothing here. For a hard-edged alpha the composited area and the regenerated area are the same region; a feathered edge is composited but only partly regenerated, because the sampler's noise mask keeps the fractional values while the composite blends them. SDXL only - the Fooocus patch does not work on distilled merges (Krea 2 Turbo, Anima Turbo, z_image_turbo); those need DifferentialDiffusion instead. Authored at denoise 0.7, the value in the pack's own refine example.
stages: RGBA source with manual transparent repair region
VAE encode & inpaint conditioning (existing content kept)
Fooocus inpaint patch applied to WAI v17
presets.execution_note: Catalog, graph and upload contract only. This preset has not been submitted to ComfyUI, visually inspected, or accepted as a correction. Node classes, links and the two inpaint filenames were confirmed against the running ComfyUI's /object_info by scripts/validate-live.py, which is a schema read and never queues work. The denoise values are read from the installed pack, not measured here: 0.7 is its refine example workflow, 1.0 is the value its other four example workflows use and the only value the core VAEEncodeForInpaint route ever permitted, and 0.5 is an interpolation inside the 1-100% range its README documents for the refine workflow.

presets.description: Style of one picture, pose of another, in one SDXL run: IP-Adapter Plus (ViT-H) reads a style board of one to three pictures (each encoded separately, embeddings averaged; measured 14 Sep 2026 that concatenating three pictures at 0.8 over-drives saturation while averaging at 0.6-0.8 keeps the palette clean) with linear weighting (measured on this ROCm PC: the 'style transfer' weight type made a full run take 260 s, linear 80 s, at the same style strength), and an OpenPose skeleton extracted from the pose picture drives Xinsir OpenPose ControlNet. Who the character is comes from the prompt and the optional LoRA slots, not from either picture. Style weight and Pose strength are the two knobs; the defaults (0.7 / 0.9) favour the pose. Semantic style transfer is not a pixel copy and pose control follows the detected skeleton, so an occluded or unusual pose can be misread. WAI v17 base: use its quality tail in the prompt.
